user.title: Connect Asyntai
user.description: Use your Asyntai AI agent as a Home Assistant conversation agent. It answers with everything it knows about your website, your products and your services. Copy your API key from [Asyntai settings]({api_key_url}).

data_description.api_key: The API key from Settings, API in your Asyntai dashboard.

website.title: Choose the website
website.description: Your account has more than one AI agent. Choose the website whose knowledge answers in Home Assistant.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter a new Asyntai API key
reauth_confirm.description: Asyntai no longer accepts the API key for {website}. Copy a new key from [Asyntai settings]({api_key_url}).

error.invalid_auth: Asyntai did not accept this API key.
error.plan_required: The Asyntai API needs the Starter plan or higher.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Asyntai. Check the internet connection of Home Assistant.
error.no_websites: This Asyntai account has no website yet. Add a website in the Asyntai dashboard first.
error.website_missing: This key belongs to an account that does not have this website.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log.

abort.reauth_successful: The new API key is saved.
